cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says ten or more services can be completed online, names a single gateway with national ID sign-in, or publishes its use.
cells.note: The revenue authority (LBR-002), the mines ministry (LBR-004) and the New York consulate (LBR-003) take applications or payments online, which answers question 1. No source counts ten or more services completed online, so it stops at stage 2.
